common_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square Chinese WeChat reaction meme, NOT a sheet. References are STYLE and CHARACTER references only, not images to edit. Match the clean expressive anime meme drawing of reference 010 and the blue-haired whale maid character of reference 056. One original chibi blue-haired whale girl with long blue hair, blue fin ears, blue whale tail, small white maid headband and navy-and-white maid outfit. Crisp dark navy outlines, simple cel shading, expressive readable face, white background. Medium close-up fills the square, generous safe margin. Exact Chinese caption centered at bottom in bold dark navy Chinese lettering with white outline, extremely readable. No other lettering, no logos, no watermark, no panels. Keep cute and playful, consistent character across collection.
